_comment: Teaching components of one service page. Shared by the App (guides/<page>_guide.dart holds the pre-written step texts) and the backend (guide.py picks a set). The model may only choose ids listed here; prerequisites are added and ordered by the validator, never by the model. capabilities: capability ids (or roots like 'fees') whose pages this guide runs on. capability_goals: the only goals that fit that sub-page, first = its default. entry_goals: components always added for that capability.
title: 繳費

components.title: 選要繳的費用
components.description: 在繳費項目清單點要繳的費用，例如水費

components.title: 輸入帳單號碼
components.description: 把帳單上的號碼（例如水號）打進框框

components.title: 按「查詢」找帳單
components.description: 號碼打好後按「查詢」，看要繳的帳單和金額

components.title: 勾選要繳的帳單
components.description: 在查到的帳單右邊打勾，選要繳哪幾張

components.title: 按「前往繳費」
components.description: 看一下總金額，按「前往繳費」

components.title: 選付款方式
components.description: 在「請選擇繳費方式」點一個常用的付款方式

components.title: 確認後按「是」付款
components.description: 看清楚費用和金額，再自己按「是」

components.title: 篩選繳費紀錄
components.description: 在繳費紀錄用上面的選單挑時間、費用或狀態
